id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying an import after its schema is deleted mid sync

review.posthog_relevance: Adds shared, centralized error handling for warehouse schema deletion, potentially removing the need for each warehouse connector to implement its own non-retryable error classification.
review.reason: Adds a try/except block around schema retrieval, catching ExternalDataSchema.DoesNotExist and delegating to a new error handler. This could establish a shared, centralized path for handling warehouse schema deletion, potentially removing the need for each warehouse connector to implement its own non-retryable error classification.
review.uncertainty: The implementation and definition of the helper function `_handle_import_error` and the exception class are absent, preventing a complete assessment of the error handling and its impact.
